blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Morgan Creek. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Morgan Creek, South Surrey and White Rock: 34 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 6 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Morgan Creek
Edgewater — 15195 36 Avenue, built 2013

A gated community in Rosemary Heights West overlooking the Nicomekl River. The building directory records the name, address and 2013 build year, and describes 14 acres with 80% designated green space and The Outlook Club amenity building; MLS listing data for the address records Apartment/Condo sub-type, Morgan Creek sub-area, built 2013, with clubhouse, exercise centre and recreation centre amenities. The directory's published restriction line: "Pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed." Published age restriction: none stated by the directory — not confirmed beyond that line. Unit count: Not confirmed — the directory states 22 units, which is inconsistent with unit numbers at this address running into the 300s in listing data, so the figure is not adopted.
Kingston House (Harvard Gardens) — 3323 151 Street, built 2014 (directory; MLS listings split 2013/2014)

The premier apartment collection at Polygon's Harvard Gardens, at 32nd Avenue and 152nd Street, with access to the 9,000 sq ft Rowing Club amenity building. The building directory records the name, address and a 2014 build year; MLS listing data for the address records Apartment/Condo sub-type, Freehold Strata title, Morgan Creek sub-area, and splits the build year between 2013 and 2014 depending on the listing — the year is therefore carried as 2013–2014 with the directory stating 2014. The directory's published restriction line: "Pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions" — the rental portion of that line is void for long-term rentals since November 24, 2022. Published age restriction: none stated — not confirmed. Unit count: Not confirmed — the directory states 22 units, inconsistent with unit numbers at this address running into the 400s in listing data, so the figure is not adopted. One directory labelling conflict is flagged: the directory's own description places this building under King George Corridor while MLS data for the address records the Morgan Creek sub-area — carried per-listing as Morgan Creek stock.
Prescott Commons (Harvard Gardens) — 15137 33 Avenue and 15138 34 Avenue, built 2018, 248 homes

The last of four phases of Polygon's Harvard Gardens: two four-storey U-shaped buildings around a landscaped courtyard, with access to the Rowing Club. Developer-era project reporting describes 248 apartments in two four-storey buildings by Polygon Prescott Commons Ltd. with occupancy spring 2018; the building directory records the name, the 15137 33 Avenue address, the 2018 build year and 248 units; an MLS data sheet for a unit records Apartment/Condo, Morgan Creek, built 2018, "Units in Dev: 248", strata plan EPS4425 and Freehold Strata title. The directory's published restriction line: "Pets allowed w/rest." — no rental line is published by the directory for this building, so its rental position beyond the province-wide rule in is not confirmed. Published age restriction: none stated — not confirmed. Note the address trap: developer-era reporting also attached the 3323 151 Street sales-centre address to this project name — the occupied buildings are the 33 Avenue / 34 Avenue pair.
Tehama — 3355 Rosemary Heights Drive, built 2008

A low-rise apartment building in Rosemary Heights; MLS listing text attributes it to Dawson Lakewood Developments (listing text, not a developer source). The building directory records the name, address and 2008 build year; MLS listing data for the address records Apartment sub-type and built 2008. The directory's published restriction line: "Pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions" — the rental portion of that line is void for long-term rentals since November 24, 2022. Published age restriction: none stated — not confirmed. Unit count: Not confirmed — the directory states 22 units, the same figure it repeats for two other unrelated buildings in this area, so it is not adopted without corroboration.
Streets, schools and getting around Morgan Creek

items.t: The community ground: Morgan Creek is the golf-course community around 32 Avenue / 160 Street, centred on Morgan Creek Golf Course at 3500 Morgan Creek Way, which describes itself as a public golf course and also runs Morgans restaurant and hosts weddings and events. Rosemary Heights lies south of the Nicomekl River, east of Highway 99 and north of Titman Creek; the City approved its local area plan in 1994 and its three neighbourhood plans in 1996 (Central), 1997 (West) and 2000 (Business Park), and now describes the area as largely built out.

Board geography: Morgan Creek is one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock" in the SnapStats data. Morgan Heights is a separate place — south of 28 Avenue and west of 164 Street, planned in 2005 in Grandview Heights — and is not part of this sub-area.
The 23% attached ratio is the second-highest in the community set, behind Sunnyside Park's 32% and ahead of King George Corridor's 21%.

Where the condo stock concentrates: in the Rosemary Heights side of the sub-area, in two clusters — Harvard Gardens at 32 Avenue / 151–152 Street (Kingston House and Prescott Commons) and the 36 Avenue corridor west of 152 Street (Edgewater at 15195 36 Avenue, Tehama at 3355 Rosemary Heights Drive) — detailed in.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Morgan Creek

items.t: Detached-lot rules that also apply in this sub-area: SSMUH allows a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; the City adopted the SSMUH zoning changes on July 8, 2024. A secondary suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling's habitable floor area under Surrey Zoning Bylaw 12000.

blocks.text: Good to know about Morgan Creek

items.t: The building directory's own description for Kingston House says "in KING GEORGE CORRIDOR", while MLS data for 3323 151 Street records the Morgan Creek sub-area and the building is marketed as Harvard Gardens, South Surrey. The building did not move; the directory label did.

Two project names were sold from one sales-centre address. Developer-era reporting for Prescott Commons gives its project location as 3323 151st Street — the address MLS data records for Kingston House — while the occupied Prescott Commons buildings stand at 15137 33 Avenue and 15138 34 Avenue. A search by address alone will mix the two Harvard Gardens buildings; confirm the strata plan (Prescott Commons is EPS4425 per an MLS data sheet) before comparing fees or sales history.

The directory's unit-count field cannot be trusted in this pocket. The same directory states "22 units" for Edgewater, Kingston House and Tehama — three unrelated buildings whose listing unit numbers run to 315, 421 and beyond. Only Prescott Commons' 248 is corroborated elsewhere. Any unit count for the other three must come from the strata plan or the Form B.
Rosemary Heights is largely built out — this is a resale market.

blocks.text: Morgan Creek home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

36 townhomes sold in Morgan Creek with a median price of $785,000 (the middle half sold between $715,000 and $1,051,250), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $489 per square foot, a median year built of 2004 and a median strata fee of $453 a month. 33 condos sold in Morgan Creek with a median price of $552,500 (the middle half sold between $525,000 and $668,800), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $656 per square foot, a median year built of 2013 and a median strata fee of $424 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 34 condos and townhomes listed in Morgan Creek. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Morgan Creek had a sales ratio of 18%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Morgan Creek from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 33 condos and townhomes sold in Morgan Creek over those 5 months, out of 456 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Is Morgan Creek the same as Morgan Crossing?
faq.a: No. Morgan Creek is the golf-course community around 32 Avenue / 160 Street with its own board sub-area row (Detached 45 / 5 / 11%; Condos & Townhomes 39 / 9 / 23% in September 2026); Morgan Crossing is the separate retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street in Grandview Heights, whose ground uses the Grandview board row.

faq.q: Which apartment condo buildings are actually in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: Four verified entries: Edgewater (15195 36 Avenue, 2013), Kingston House at Harvard Gardens (3323 151 Street, 2014 per the directory, listings split 2013/2014), Prescott Commons at Harvard Gardens (15137 33 Avenue / 15138 34 Avenue, 2018, 248 homes), and Tehama (3355 Rosemary Heights Drive, 2008).

faq.q: How did Morgan Creek sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Medians are published at community level only (detached $1,628,000; attached $700,000), not for this sub-area.

faq.q: What is Harvard Gardens, and what is the Rowing Club?
faq.a: Harvard Gardens is Polygon's master-planned community at 32 Avenue / 151–152 Street. Its two apartment buildings verified here are Kingston House (the premier apartment collection, launched first) and Prescott Commons (the last of four phases, 248 homes, occupied spring 2018). Both give residents access to the Rowing Club, the community's 9,000 sq ft amenity building with pool, gym, theatre and guest suites, per the buildings' own directory and listing descriptions.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Morgan Creek condo, and can I keep a pet?
faq.a: Long-term rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022 — the directory's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" lines for Kingston House and Tehama cannot restrict a long-term rental; short-term rentals can still be restricted. All four verified buildings publish "Pets allowed w/rest." lines — pet rules remain enforceable bylaws, so read the registered bylaws attached to the Form B for the specific building.

faq.q: What should I read before buying at Wedgewood or Sundance?
faq.a: The Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report, plus what the monthly fees include.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Morgan Creek townhome?
faq.a: Long-term rental-restriction bylaws have been void province-wide since November 24, 2022, so the strata cannot enforce one — including any directory line saying rentals are allowed only with restrictions.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Morgan Creek sell for?
faq.a: 36 townhomes sold in Morgan Creek between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $785,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Morgan Creek?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
